comparison.objective: Transport an opaque collar along a curved protected guide to a target support.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain clearance through changing occlusions while moving an already-threaded collar around a curved route.
comparison.success_condition: Collar reaches the target aligned, supported, released and still; prohibited contact permanently forces zero.
comparison.reason: Tests occlusion-aware constrained transport and contact avoidance, not impact-generated separation and fragment containment.
